user.title: Add a PiyoLog feed
user.description: Paste the data feed URL issued in PiyoLog. The URL contains a secret, so keep it private.

data_description.name: Shown on the device and cards. PiyoLog does not provide it.

reauth_confirm.title: Feed URL is no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The feed was revoked, expired or suspended. Paste a new feed URL.

error.invalid_url: This is not a PiyoLog feed URL.
error.feed_unavailable: The feed is unavailable. Check that the URL is correct and not expired or revoked.
error.response_too_large: The feed is too large. Issue a feed with a shorter period.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach PiyoLog. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: PiyoLog returned a response this integration cannot read.

data_description.scan_interval: PiyoLog caches feeds for 1 to 15 minutes, so shorter intervals rarely help.
